data.name: The Smiling Flesh
data.detailed_description:
The Smiling Flesh is a tense, single-player survival horror where every sound and wrong turn could be your last. As a thief seeking a priceless treasure, you infiltrate a decaying gothic mansion—only to become the prey. The twisted, smiling owner knows you are here and will stop at nothing to claim you. Explore, solve puzzles, and stay one step ahead of the horror stalking the halls.

Key Features

A Hunter That Learns Your Movements

The creature doesn't just patrol the mansion; it reacts to your choices.

  • Predictive Pursuit: It tracks your movements and anticipates your next steps to cut off escape routes instead of blindly chasing you.

  • Every Sound Matters: Running, slamming doors, or careless actions will reveal your position. This is not a silent escape; every creak draws the entity straight to you.

  • Hide, Evade, Survive: Break line of sight, manage your noise, and hide in wardrobes or dark closets to outlast the relentless pursuit and the evil lurking in the shadows.

Explore the Mansion's Secrets

Progression relies on uncovering hidden mechanisms and solving intricate puzzles.

  • Freedom to Explore: Navigate interconnected rooms, revisit areas, and choose your path—while always watching your back.

  • Handcrafted Progression: Solve uniquely designed puzzles integrated naturally into the environment to gradually unlock new sections of the estate.

  • Environmental Storytelling: Uncover hidden passages, forgotten relics, and unsettling clues woven directly into the mansion. Learn the dark history of the former resident who once ruled these halls.

An Atmospheric Survival Horror Experience

  • A Decaying Mansion: Brave rain-soaked graveyards, abandoned halls, and the disturbing, dusty portraits of a twisted grandfather and a decaying granny who once called this nightmare home.

  • Constant Tension: Catching a glimpse of a slender shadow moving at the end of a dark hallway is just the beginning. Every corridor is a risk, and a locked door might hide your next clue—or the creature waiting for you.

  • Unpredictable Horror: An oppressive atmosphere, carefully crafted scares, and a relentless AI keep the terror high from start to finish.

Will you outsmart The Smiling Flesh, claim the treasure, and escape... or will the mansion claim another victim?

Silence is your only sanctuary, but The Smiling Flesh is listening to every step.

Solve puzzles, explore forgotten halls, and outsmart a twisted entity that learns your movements. Find the treasure, or become the mansion's next victim.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 Ti 4 GB / RX 570 4 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
